thread:
Aisha (Product PM): ACME asked for a tenant-prefetch feature (weights + KV prefixes) to cut cold-start tails. They want a Q3 pilot. Need quick cross-team agreement on scope, launch gates, and resourcing.
Dan (Eng): confirm pilot is per-tenant opt-in and product toggles? rollback must be immediate if OOMs spike.
Aisha (Product PM): yes opt-in. Goals: reduce cold-start p95 for opted tenants, keep global p95 stable, cost delta <=8%.
Priya (Runtime): runtime risks: memory/KV eviction and interfering with batching. Proposal: ranked prefetch queue, off-peak windows, warmed TTL, and hard cap on concurrent prefetches.
Priya (Runtime): will add metrics: prefetch_queue_len, prefetch_success_pct, warmed_tenants_count, prefetch_gpu_mins. Low-cardinality only.
Jorge (Infra): infra needs GPU-min estimate per tenant and concurrency to size burst capacity. If new SKUs needed provisioning ~48-72h. I'll open a ticket.
Lena (Security): confirm ephemeral memory-only cache; need opt-in audit events and a short security review for KMS usage.
Aisha (Product PM): correct ephemeral. Product requires opt-in audit event and a policy that prefetch cannot access PII.
Dan (Eng): suggested timeline for MVP: 2w spike (runtime+infra), internal canary week 3 (5 tenants), 2-week canary validation, then customer pilot.
Priya (Runtime): runtime acceptance: >=40% reduction in cold-start p95 on test tenants; peak overhead <5%; feature-flag rollback drains queue and evicts warm flags within 60s.
Lena (Security): I'll do review (estimate 6h) and sign off on audit events.
Jorge (Infra): ack 18h to tune autoscaler + open ticket; +48h if new SKUs.
Dan (Eng): ack 36h (impl + tests).
Priya (Runtime): ack 48h (queue, metrics, feature flag, tests).
OncallBot: deploy scheduled: deploy/canary-prefetch 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z -> will notify #eng-oncall.
Aisha (Product PM): thanks — I'll draft the spec and add to the Q3 slate. Please flag any blockers here by EOD.
